desc:
Microwave Dinner is a game with lots of badges to collect! Inspired by 3D Platformer classics.
You are a microwave robot on a journey to collect food, power your fridge spaceship, and make it back home to earth. 🌎

[World 1] 🌴 Explore the tropical world of Blue Fort Port and help the many blobs who live there!
[World 2] 🌆 Explore Robo Junk City and meet the various robots who live there!
[World 3] 🥕 Explore Clockfork Kingdom and become a hero in a sky land full of silverware! Out now!

▶ Earn the many fun badges and look for them with your friends. Can you collect them all?

▶ Help support the game by buying paint colors! Thank you everyone who supports! You are tremendously important to the success of the game!

🎮 Xbox and PlayStation controllers supported ✅
Play with a controller if you have one!

📢 Follow the game's socials for news about the game and join the community server! 💬
